---
title: "n vs B exploration"
format: html
---
```{r}
set.seed(5405)  
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

hist(replicate(200,   mean(rexp(5))),  breaks = 30, main = "n = 5, B = 200")
hist(replicate(10000, mean(rexp(5))),  breaks = 30, main = "n = 5, B = 10000")
hist(replicate(200,   mean(rexp(50))), breaks = 30, main = "n = 50, B = 200")
hist(replicate(10000, mean(rexp(50))), breaks = 30, main = "n = 50, B = 10000")

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
```{r}
source("R/clt_functions.R")

set.seed(5405)
test_means <- simulate_means(function(n) rexp(n, rate = 1), n = 30)

length(test_means)
mean(test_means)
sd(test_means)
1 / sqrt(30)
```
```{r}
source("R/clt_functions.R")

skew <- function(x) mean((x - mean(x))^3) / mean((x - mean(x))^2)^(3/2)
kurt <- function(x) mean((x - mean(x))^4) / mean((x - mean(x))^2)^2 - 3

set.seed(5405)
unif_1  <- simulate_means(function(n) runif(n), n = 1)
norm_1  <- simulate_means(function(n) rnorm(n), n = 1)

c(skew_unif = skew(unif_1), kurt_unif = kurt(unif_1))
c(skew_norm = skew(norm_1), kurt_norm = kurt(norm_1))

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
qqnorm(unif_1, main = "Uniform, n = 1"); qqline(unif_1)
qqnorm(norm_1, main = "Normal, n = 1");  qqline(norm_1)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
```{r}
source("R/clt_functions.R")

set.seed(5405)
exp_100 <- simulate_means(function(n) rexp(n, rate = 1), n = 100)

skew(exp_100)     
kurt(exp_100)
qq_cor(exp_100)   
```

```{r}
source("R/clt_functions.R")
check_normal(exp_100)
```

set.seed(5405)
